nodes.description: Public counter holding the next token id to be minted.
Address privileged to set base URI and transfer ownership.
Mapping of nonces already consumed by minting signatures.
Constructor initializing tokenCounter and owner from msg.sender.
Owner-gated transfer of contract ownership to a new address.
Internal signature check using ecrecover against the stored owner.
External mint entry point that verifies a signature, mints and sets URI.
Owner-gated update of the base token URI.
External burn of an existing token after ownership check.
msg.sender captured in the constructor as the initial owner.
msg.sender compared in the onlyOwner access-control modifier.
msg.sender used as the mint recipient and signature caller in createCollectible.
ecrecover call on a user supplied Sign struct to authorize minting.
External onERC721Received call performed by _safeMint before minting state is finalized.
Token metadata URI supplied by the caller of createCollectible.
Royalty fee supplied by the caller of createCollectible.
Sign struct (v, r, s, nonce) supplied by the caller of createCollectible.
New owner address supplied to transferOwnership.
Token id supplied to burn.
New base URI string supplied to setBaseURI.
Local copy of tokenCounter used as the minted token id.
Local keccak256 digest of contract, caller, tokenURI and nonce.

edges.reason: msg.sender from the constructor is stored directly into the owner state variable, making the deploying account privileged.
The onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner before transferOwnership executes.
The onlyOwner modifier gates setBaseURI on the msg.sender check.
transferOwnership overwrites the owner state variable, changing who passes the privileged checks.
createCollectible trusts msg.sender both as the signature subject and as the mint recipient.
tokenURI parameter flows into createCollectible where it is hashed and stored via _setTokenURI.
fee parameter flows into createCollectible and is written to the royalty mapping during minting.
sign parameter flows into createCollectible where its nonce is consumed and its signature verified.
The Sign struct members v, r, s and nonce flow from the caller into verifySign.
createCollectible invokes verifySign, so minting is only permitted when the recovered signer equals owner.
createCollectible sets the usedNonce entry to true before minting, consuming the quoted nonce.
createCollectible reads tokenCounter into the newItemId local variable used for minting.
createCollectible increments tokenCounter after minting, so the counter write follows the external call.
createCollectible reaches _safeMint which performs an external onERC721Received call before tokenCounter is incremented and the URI is set.
The external onERC721Received callback executes under the caller's control and can re-enter createCollectible before state finalization.
The locally computed hash is fed into ecrecover, whose result authorizes the mint when it equals owner.
verifySign compares the ecrecover result with the stored owner address to enforce the signature gate.
newOwner parameter from transferOwnership is validated and written into the owner state variable.
tokenId parameter flows into burn, which checks existence and ownership before destroying the token.
baseURI parameter flows into setBaseURI and is stored through _setBaseURI by the privileged owner.

normalization_plan.reason: parameter tokenURI is only used inside createCollectible and should be folded into that core function node.
parameter fee is only used inside createCollectible and should be folded into that core function node.
parameter sign is consumed by createCollectible and forwarded to verifySign, so it merges into the minting function node.
parameter newOwner is only used by transferOwnership and should be folded into that core function node.
parameter tokenId is only used by burn and should be folded into that core function node.
parameter _baseURI is only used by setBaseURI and should be folded into that core function node.
local newItemId is a temporary alias of tokenCounter inside createCollectible and should be folded into that core function node.
local hash is the digest supplied to the ecrecover unsafe operation in verifySign and should be folded into that unsafe operation node.
